name: Adaptive Grid Optical Tomography
definition: A volumetric reconstruction method that uses an adaptive grid (octree) to represent the 3D density field, allowing for higher effective resolution and better memory efficiency than uniform grids by using fewer basis functions in uniform regions.
summary: Adaptive Grid Optical Tomography is a volumetric reconstruction method using an adaptive octree grid to achieve higher resolution and memory efficiency than uniform grids by refining resolution only where reconstruction error is high.
